notes: Five distinct manipulation episodes are visible. The last two involve separate folding side platforms of the barbecue; their transition estimates are less certain because the camera is strongly rotated and the parts are intermittently occluded.
scene_description: A first-person camera surveys an apartment balcony containing an adjustable white lounge chair and a compact stainless-steel gas barbecue. The user raises and lowers the chair backrest, then manipulates the barbecue's main lid, lower cabinet door, and two side platforms.
